title: Pass the torch
description: Ultra hardcore minecraft inspired from FlamingMoai's UHC: Generations, when you die the world will pass to a new player.
body:
This datapack sets your world in ultra hardcore mode (no natural health regeneration), and when you die you can pass the world to someone else, setting it automatically in survival mode when a new player opens it.
Also when near your respawn location a scoreboard will appear on the right side of the screen with the total playtime of you and the past owners of the world.
